root_cause.text: The dwc2_hsotg_udc_stop() function in the dwc2 gadget driver calls dwc2_gadget_exit_clock_gating() without holding hsotg->lock, violating the locking assumption of the call_gadget() macro invoked inside that function, leading to unbalanced spin_unlock/spin_lock operations and a deadlock.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explains that dwc2_gadget_exit_clock_gating() internally uses call_gadget(), which expects hsotg->lock to be held for its spin_unlock/spin_lock around gadget callbacks. The patch adds spin_lock_irqsave()/spin_unlock_irqrestore() around the call to correct the mismatch.
